title: WeQuant service models
description: Each operation's request and result, and Failure, the body of a failed one. From: uv run wequant schema --json > frontend/contract/service-models.schema.json

Bars.description: Each cell's values: prices and amount in yuan, volume in shares, adj_* back-adjusted, masks 1.0/0.0.
Bars.title: Bars

BarsRequest.description: Panel fields of a few codes over a date range.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

codes.description: Codes such as 600000.SH, in output order.

start.description: First day (default: the first trading day).

end.description: Last day (default: the last trading day).

BarsRequest.title: BarsRequest

CheckReport.description: The check's counts and report; ok when a current check is recorded and, in a dry run, every breach is too.

ok.description: True when the check found nothing to act on.

committed.description: New version, or null if none was made.

current.description: The final version (committed, else checked) records a current limit check.

breaches.description: Bars that trade outside their limits.

missing.description: Breaches found but not recorded at data_version.

stale.description: Breaches recorded at data_version but no longer found.

report_path.description: The report's path relative to the data root, written on commit.

report.description: The markdown report, as written on commit.

CheckReport.title: CheckReport

CheckRequest.description: The price-limit check of the current store version.

commit.description: Record breaches and the limit_check block in a new version under the writer lock, and write the report.

CheckRequest.title: CheckRequest

DataStatus.description: One store version: its tables and meta, next to the versions the store keeps.

limit_check_current.description: The version records a limit check of its own inputs with the current rule book.

meta.description: Every other manifest key, such as source and limit_check.

DataStatus.title: DataStatus

EvalRequest.description: A form evaluated for a few codes over a date range.

form.description: Canonical form as JSON text, e.g. '["MA","adj_close",20]' or '"close"'.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

codes.description: Codes such as 600000.SH, in output order.

start.description: First day (default: the first trading day).

end.description: Last day (default: the last trading day).

EvalRequest.title: EvalRequest

EvalResult.description: The form's value in each cell, as values.value.
EvalResult.title: EvalResult

Exit.description: Exit codes of the wequant command; README.md lists the same table.
Exit.title: Exit

ExprCheck.description: A valid expression's canonical key and kind.

key.description: Canonical compact JSON: what results are cached and archived by.

kind.description: num for a number, bool for a condition (1.0/0.0).

ExprCheck.title: ExprCheck

ExprRequest.description: A signal expression in canonical form.

form.description: Canonical form as JSON text, e.g. '["MA","adj_close",20]' or '"close"'.

ExprRequest.title: ExprRequest

Failure.description: A failed operation: the exit code its command ends with and why; the error body of the HTTP API.
Failure.title: Failure

IssueCount.description: Matching rows of one (table, kind, action).
IssueCount.title: IssueCount

IssueRow.description: One data_issues row; detail is its JSON text as stored.
IssueRow.title: IssueRow

Issues.description: The matching rows: their total, their counts and the first limit of them by (table, code, date, kind).
Issues.title: Issues

IssuesRequest.description: data_issues rows to list, by exact match on each given filter.

data_version.description: Store version to read (default: the current one).

codes.description: Affected codes; data_issues keeps a malformed code as found.

limit.description: Rows to return at most; total and counts cover every match.

IssuesRequest.title: IssuesRequest

OperationModels.description: One operation and the names of its request and result models.

operation.description: The function in wequant.service, e.g. data_bars for wequant data bars.

OperationModels.title: OperationModels

Row.description: One (date, code) cell; a value is null where the panel holds NaN or infinity.

status.description: The descriptive day status: a later bar can change it.

Row.title: Row

SchemaRequest.description: The JSON Schema of every service model.
SchemaRequest.title: SchemaRequest

ServiceSchema.description: A JSON Schema document: $defs holds every service model by name, in alphabetical order.

description.default: Each operation's request and result, and Failure, the body of a failed one. From: uv run wequant schema --json > frontend/contract/service-models.schema.json

operations.description: Each operation's request and result model, in the order of the commands.

$defs.description: Each model's JSON Schema by name.

ServiceSchema.title: ServiceSchema
